title: Dog microchip registration in Poland
question: Is microchipping my dog mandatory in Poland?
short_answer: Microchipping is mandatory for dogs in most Polish municipalities. It is also required to register in the national animal database. Cost: 50–100 PLN at a vet.
conditions: Microchipping (czipowanie) is mandatory in most Polish cities and municipalities
After chipping: register in the national database (Safe Animal — Bezpieczny Zwierzak or local registry)
Done at any veterinary clinic — cost: 50–100 PLN
The chip contains a unique 15-digit ISO code readable by any vet scanner
Dogs brought from abroad must also be registered in Polish databases
exceptions: National law does not uniformly require chipping — check your local municipality regulations (gmina)
Cats are not required to be chipped nationally, but it is strongly recommended
If your dog is lost: chip is the fastest way to identify the owner
penalties: Varies by municipality: fine up to 500 PLN for unregistered/unchipped dog
Straż Miejska enforces local animal regulations
